final_message: None of the available tools can retrieve a receipt from an external artifact vault. The tools I have access to are limited to: recalling session episodes, git operations (commit, diff, status) on repository history, repository operations (build, edit, find, read, status), and test operations (focus, list, run) on the repository test suite — all scoped to a code repository and session context, not an external artifact/document storage system. I have no tool capable of connecting to or querying an external vault for receipts or similar artifacts.
